# Bajrang Stay Inn

> A quiet hotel stay in Kodinar, Gujarat, minutes from Somnath Temple and the Saurashtra coast. Comfortable rooms, free Wi-Fi, free parking, breakfast and a 24/7 front desk.

## Stay

- [Rooms](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/rooms): Room types with photos, amenities and nightly rates.
- [Amenities](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/amenities): What is included with every stay.
- [Gallery](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/gallery): Photos of the hotel and its rooms.

## Book and contact

- [Book a room](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/book): Send a booking request for your dates.
- [Contact](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/contact): Address, phone and directions.

## Travel guides

- [Guides](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/guide): Nearby places and trip ideas around Kodinar and Somnath.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/privacy-policy): How guest data is handled.
- [Terms and conditions](https://bajrang-rest-inn.vercel.app/terms-conditions): Booking terms.
